books.title: Whispers in the Water
books.description: Beneath the shimmering surface of Lake Eacham, a mysterious whisper calls to Thistlewink, the tiny colour-shifting fae creature with a brave heart. When strange ripples and fading magic disturb the peaceful rainforest, Thistlewink and her loyal Shimmerling must journey into a hidden world below the water: glowing caverns, ancient secrets, and gentle underwater creatures reveal a mystery only she can solve. A tender, enchanting adventure about courage, friendship, and the quiet magic that lives in nature.

books.title: The Adventures of Thistlewink - The Lost Joey of Mount Hypipamee
books.author: Briony Bramble
books.description:
The Adventures of Thistlewink. Book One invites young readers into a gentle, magical world hidden deep within the rainforest of the Atherton Tablelands in Far North Queensland. Thistlewink is a tiny fei creature with a chameleon's gift for changing colour, her hues shifting softly with every emotion. She lives quietly among ancient trees, glowing fungi, and the secret rhythms of the forest, until the day a shimmer of magic ripples through the canopy and calls her into her very first adventure.

When a young red pademelon becomes lost near Mt Hypipamee, Thistlewink must follow glowing clues, listen to the whispers of the forest, and trust her own courage. Along the way she meets wise fei companions, gentle rainforest creatures, and the natural wonders that shape her world. Through each step of her journey, she learns that even the smallest being can bring comfort, kindness, and hope.

This beautifully illustrated story blends soft fantasy with real Australian landscapes, celebrating the unique wildlife and rainforest life of the Atherton Tablelands. Themes of friendship, belonging, emotional expression, courage, and the quiet magic of nature run throughout the book, making it ideal for families who value warm storytelling and calming, imaginative adventures.

As the first title in the series, this book introduces Thistlewink's world and the fei friends who will join her in future stories. With its soothing tone and heartfelt message, The Adventures of Thistlewink and Her Fei Friends offers a gentle reading experience filled with wonder, colour, and the beauty of the natural world.

books.title: The Housekeepers Journal
books.author: Helen Poulos
books.description:
A gentle, practical companion for creating a calm and organised home
Bring clarity and confidence to your daily routines with this beautifully structured one hundred and eleven page journal. Designed for women who want order without overwhelm, it supports budgeting, cleaning rhythms, and seasonal refreshes all year long.
Inside You Will Find
• Twelve month budget planner to track spending and stay in control
• Daily cleaning prompts that keep your home feeling fresh and manageable
• Weekly cleaning structure that removes decision fatigue
• Monthly cleaning checklists for deeper home care
• Seasonal cleaning ideas to refresh your space throughout the year
• Decluttering guidance to help you let go of what no longer serves you
• Space for notes, reflections, and gentle accountability
Ideal For
• Anyone wanting a calmer and more organised home
• Busy women who need simple structure and clear routines
• Homemakers who love practical tools with a warm tone
• Gift givers looking for something beautiful and genuinely useful
Why Buyers Choose This Journal
• It reduces stress by breaking tasks into small achievable steps
• It supports long term habits rather than quick fixes
• It brings order to both home and finances in one place
• It feels encouraging rather than demanding

books.title: Little Mental Health Helpers: Daily Gratitude Journal
books.author: CP Creates
books.description:
Written by my daughter who is a qualified Vet Nurse and has had training in the Mental Health areas
this beautifully designed guided journal is part of the Little Mental Health Helpers collection — gentle companions created to support your emotional well-being in small, meaningful ways. Inside, you’ll begin a simple yet life-changing 28-day gratitude practice that helps you slow down, reconnect with what matters, and rediscover joy in everyday moments.

Whether you're seeking more positivity, recovering from stress, or wanting to build healthier mental habits, this journal offers a warm and encouraging space to reflect, breathe, and grow.


What Makes This Gratitude Journal Different?
28-Day Guided Cycle - A focused month of gratitude pages that makes starting (and finishing!) a reflective practice feel easy and achievable.
Daily Gratitude + Rotating Prompts - Each day includes space to write three things you’re grateful for and a meaningful question designed to spark self-awareness, perspective, and inner calm.
Daily, Uplifting Affirmations - A new gratitude-themed affirmation every day helps you shift your mindset gently and naturally.
Monthly Reflection (Day 28) - Look back on your emotional growth, habits, and mental shifts with a thoughtful review page.
Six-Month Close-Out Section - After six completed cycles, you’ll have a powerful snapshot of how gratitude has changed your life.
Notes & Doodle Pages Included - Extra space at the back of the book for free writing, creative expression, or recording meaningful ideas.
Portable, Comfortable Size (5 x 8 in) - Perfect for your bedside table, desk, bag, or morning routine.
A Small Daily Habit with a Big Emotional Impact
By the end of your first 28-day cycle, you’ll feel more present, more grounded, and more connected to what truly brings you joy. This isn’t just a journal — it's a gentle companion for your mental and emotional well-being.
